question: What is a DC LVDT?

options.text: It operates on AC power supply and has an AC output
It operates on DC power supply and has an AC output
It operates on DC power supply and has a DC output

solution:
A **DC LVDT** (Linear Variable Differential Transformer) is an electromechanical transducer that **operates on a DC power supply and has a DC output**.

__**Explanation:**__

While a traditional LVDT is inherently an AC device, a "DC LVDT" contains internal electronic circuitry to make it compatible with DC systems.

How a DC LVDT Works

To provide DC-in/DC-out functionality, the housing of the sensor includes a micro-electronic circuit consisting of:

 
• 
 
**An Oscillator:** This converts the incoming DC input into the high-frequency AC required to excite the primary coil.

 
 
• 
 
**A Demodulator and Filter:** This takes the AC output from the secondary coils, converts it back into a DC voltage, and smooths the signal.
